description: The three doctrines (concept §6.1). Chosen once per campaign and never changed. Each is a different set of prices, not a better or worse start: a doctrine makes some vehicles cheap and forbids others outright, which is what makes two campaigns diverge rather than repaint.

doctrines.title: Mass & Volume
doctrines.summary: Build many, build cheap, accept that some of them misbehave.
doctrines.lockedQaReason: Hot fire needs a test stand you have not built. Propulsion level 3 unlocks it.

doctrines.title: Precision
doctrines.summary: Fewer vehicles, each one known down to the decimal.
doctrines.lockedQaReason: Series production is not certified under this doctrine. Every unit is tested.

doctrines.title: Science
doctrines.summary: Instruments first, money later, and an investor who can wait.
